description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of samples generated and the Micro F1 score for three different methods. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and has a linear scale ranging from 8 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 8 (K=8, K=16, K=32, K=64). The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 50, with tick labels at intervals of 5.  A blue line, marked with diamond shapes, represents TACRED, starting at a value of approximately 28% at K=8 and increasing to approximately 31% at K=64. An orange line, marked with circular shapes, represents TACRED-Revisit, beginning at approximately 42% at K=8 and decreasing to approximately 31% at K=64. A red line, marked with triangular shapes, represents SemEval, starting at approximately 47% at K=8 and increasing to approximately 52% at K=64.
